decisive_spans.text: diffuse granular shadows on right side
bronchial wall thickening and numerous granular shadows

response.rationale: D4 is supported by the presence of diffuse granular shadows and bronchial wall thickening, which are key features of Chronic Hypersensitivity Pneumonitis. D2 is also supported by diffuse granular shadows and inflammatory cell infiltration, but the lack of fibrosis in one biopsy and the presence of fibrosis in another makes it less clear-cut than D4. The other candidates have contradictions or less direct support.
